name: Mukul Mishra/ମୁକୁଲ୍ ମିଶ୍ର

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Mukul Mishra is an Odia poet from Bolangir. Her collections include Apoorna, Meghamanaa and Maayalagna; Rupasi, published by Black Eagle Books, is a long poem in thirty-six sections. Sahitya Akademi’s record of its 2014 Asmita programme in Bolangir places her among the participating Odia women writers who read their work.

Her Kabita Live poems bring night, light and household life into close conversation. ‘ରାତି’ moves through sleeplessness and unsettling imaginings towards the small preparations of a kitchen and another dawn. In ‘ଭଉଁରି-୨୧’, lamps, fireworks and a moth’s attraction to flame reveal how illumination can carry tenderness and pain together. A mother’s presence gives those images their emotional centre.
